hero.label: Our story
hero.headline: Great produce. *Every time.*
paragraphs: We started out as the Good Hope Café on Hither Green Lane in 2010. During lockdown in 2020 we changed our name to Found Hope, and turned our focus to the great produce we'd found.
The idea was simple. Fill a neighbourhood shop with things we love, then share them with the people who live round the corner.

history.label: The shop
history.headline: A café on this corner *since 2010*
history.imageAlt: Illustration of the Found Hope shopfront on Hither Green Lane

timeline.text: Good Hope Café opens at 216–218 Hither Green Lane.
During lockdown, Good Hope becomes Found Hope, with a new focus on great products from the small producers we'd found.
Run by chef Nick and his team, with produce from our favourite small suppliers and plenty made in our own kitchen.

items.title: People
items.text: A warm welcome for everyone who walks in. Respect for our customers, our team and our suppliers.

items.title: Community
items.text: A proper neighbourhood shop. We're here for Hither Green, and we want everyone to feel at home.

items.title: Product
items.text: Great produce, every time. Seasonal, from our favourite suppliers, and made by us when we can.

items.title: Sustainability
items.text: Low waste, growers who care for the land, and a shop built to be here for the long run.

nick.label: Owner and chef
nick.headline: Meet *Nick*
nick.imageAlt: Squash soup with pumpkin seeds and sourdough, from Nick's kitchen
paragraphs: Nick trained as a commis chef at Brocket Hall in Hertfordshire, where at 18 he met his lifelong friend Bill.

In 2000 he moved to London to cook under Marcus Wareing at Pétrus. He went on to work in some of the city's best kitchens: the Savoy Grill, Pétrus again as it won two Michelin stars, La Noisette, Eastside Inn and Michelin-starred Wild Honey. He then led the kitchens at the Gilbert Scott and Ealing Park Tavern.
In 2020 he came full circle, joining Bill as head chef at Found Hope. When Bill decided to sell, Nick saw a legacy worth protecting and bought it himself.
nick.team: Around him, Nick has built a team of passionate, like-minded people who are the heart and soul of Found Hope. They love nothing more than sharing what they know about food and drink with you.
